learning_outcomes.text: Uses punctuation marks correctly in Turkish texts.
Knows oral and written expression types.
Develops Turkish writing and expression skills.
Knows bibliography and citation rules used in scientific studies.
Learns institutional/official correspondence rules and writes official/institutional texts (petitions, CVs, reports, etc.).
Uses Turkish consciously, correctly, and meticulously.
Reinforces multidimensional layers of meaning in Turkish words and texts.
Evaluates instructional and literary texts in terms of structure and content.
